support.logs.title: Logs
support.logs.noMatches: No log files match the filter
support.logs.helpText: View and download the log files of the Astrum Repository server. Each node writes the application log to its own file, astrum-<node>.log. Insert marks into the log to find the events you look for more easily.
support.viewer.title: Log Viewer
support.logging.title: Logging
support.logging.name: Logger Name
support.logging.resetText: Return every logger to its default level? This cannot be undone.
support.logging.resetDone: Every logger is back at its default level
support.logging.helpText: Set the log levels of the parts of Astrum Repository. More detailed logs help to find the cause of a problem but can slow the server down. Resetting to the defaults returns every logger to its original level.
support.logger.name: Logger Name
support.logger.nameHelp: The full name of the logger, a Rust module path (for example, astrum_content::proxy)
support.logger.nameInvalid: Use ROOT or a Rust module path such as astrum_api::routes
support.logger.levelHelp: From ERROR (the fewest messages) to TRACE (the most)
support.logger.overrides: The level set here replaces the one inherited from the parent logger.
support.logger.deleteToRevert: Delete to return to the inherited level.
support.logger.removed: The level override of {name} was removed
support.logger.deleteText: Remove the log level set for {name}? The logger inherits the level of its parent again and leaves the list of configured loggers.
support.sysinfo.title: System Information
support.sysinfo.intro: Detailed information about the system and the server
support.sysinfo.helpText: This page gathers details about this Astrum Repository server: versions, runtime, database and configuration. Save them with Download to attach them to a support request.
support.health.title: Metric Health
support.health.select: Select a check to see its details
support.health.helpText: This page shows the checks that watch the important parts of the server. Red marks show the parts that may need your attention.
support.zip.title: Support ZIP
support.zip.intro: Create a ZIP file with information about this server that helps support
support.zip.noSend: Nothing is sent to GlobalArt when the support ZIP is created.
support.zip.mayTake: Creating the support ZIP can take a few minutes.
support.zip.limitFiles: Limit each file in the ZIP archive to 30 MB
support.zip.limitZip: Limit the ZIP archive to 50 MB
support.zip.failed: Failed to create the support ZIP
support.zip.createdText: The support ZIP was created. Find it on the server's file system or download it in the browser.
support.zip.truncated: Size limits cut the support ZIP short.
